clips.title: The story
paras: Mountaineers guard the road through North Gate Outpost, where Dun Morogh meets Loch Modan. Their patrols keep travelers safe from the beasts in the crags.

Dwarven mountaineers guard the road through North Gate Pass. From North Gate Outpost, they keep the route clear of prowling beasts and watch travelers heading through the mountain tunnels into Loch Modan. The pass is Dun Morogh’s northeastern threshold, but its harsh weather and steep ravines make patrols dangerous. When a patrol goes missing or a predator threatens the road, the garrison calls on travelers to scout the surrounding ridges.
